capabilities: weixin-messaging | Sends messages from a logged-in Weixin account and exposes received messages through its HTTP API.
description:
Each enrollment runs Kadxy's MIT-licensed Weixin iLink gateway in a separate container. It connects a logged-in WeChat account to an HTTP API for messaging, media and webhooks. This prototype uses temporary storage: stopping or replacing the instance loses login state, message cursors and buffered messages.

Enroll in the base channel and keep or replace the generated WEIXIN_API_KEY and WEBHOOK_TOKEN parameters. Open /console at your instance URL, enter the application API key and scan the WeChat login QR code. Call the REST API with `Authorization: Bearer <key>`; the webhook endpoint uses its token instead. See How to use this service for full setup and limitations.

You pay the selected channel's platform compute cost while the instance runs, including idle time. Labs adds no markup and receives no seller payout. See the upstream gateway documentation and issue tracker for software-specific help.

summary: A private WeChat iLink Bot HTTP gateway per enrollment, with QR login, messaging, media, and webhooks.

base.description: One isolated gateway for one enrollment; temporary storage.

WEBHOOK_TOKEN.description: Generated for this enrollment; keep it or enter your own (at least 12 characters). It is the secret in the gateway's inbound webhook URL, https://<instance>/webhook/<token>: anyone with that URL can send a message to the WeChat account you log in with, so keep it private. Use it with the msg-to-weixin service. Save it now: the platform keeps it as a secret and does not show it again.
WEBHOOK_TOKEN.title: Webhook token

WEIXIN_API_KEY.description: Generated for this enrollment; keep it or enter your own key of at least 12 characters, and save it. It is the Bearer token for the gateway's REST API and what the console asks for at login. Set it before the instance starts; changing it later restarts the instance. Save it now: the platform keeps it as a secret and does not show it again.
WEIXIN_API_KEY.title: Weixin API key
